title: Backup / Restore Lifecycle

environment.controller_block_reason: No ESP32 controller runtime is available in this environment; do not infer remote apply/ack from the MQTT broker-only roundtrip.

includes: real PostgreSQL rollback after injected domain failure
real PostgreSQL export + preview + atomic apply + repeated apply no-duplicate check

covers: preview endpoint is called before restore
validated artifact is sent unchanged to restore

frontend_build.notes: TypeScript and Vite production build completed; existing large-chunk warning remains non-blocking.

targeted_eslint.command: npm exec eslint src/hooks/useConfigBackup.ts src/pages/ConfigBackup.tsx src/pages/ConfigBackup.test.tsx

mqtt_roundtrip.details: Temporary eclipse-mosquitto:2 broker accepted a publish and subscriber received the exact test payload over localhost:1883. Broker was stopped after verification.

AC-1.basis: Versioned hydragrow-backup envelope with schema_version=1 and canonical SHA-256 digest.

AC-2.basis: Existing ownership/auth guard is reused; export/restore require write:config or device:admin; exported persistent configuration is checked for forbidden secret keys.

AC-3.basis: Export reads all five required persistent configuration domains inside one PostgreSQL transaction and fails closed when a required domain is absent.

AC-4.basis: Dedicated /restore/validate endpoint performs integrity/schema/domain/target validation and deterministic preview without mutation.

AC-5.basis: Unsupported fields, missing fields, bad source identity, secrets, unsupported format/schema and digest mismatch are rejected.

AC-6.basis: Target ownership is checked before validation/apply and is enforced by the existing device ownership boundary.

AC-7.basis: All persistent configuration domains and optional recipe template apply inside one PostgreSQL transaction.

AC-8.basis: Remote sync is invoked only after commit; response distinguishes applied_sync_pending from applied_sync_failed and never rolls DB back for remote failure.

AC-9.basis: Executable PostgreSQL test injects a later-domain failure and verifies the earlier domain change is absent after rollback.

AC-10.basis: Source device is explicitly mapped to path target; recipe identity conflicts fail closed; ownership remains target-scoped.

AC-11.basis: Configuration uses ON CONFLICT upserts and the PostgreSQL roundtrip test applies the same artifact twice while verifying one logical device row.

AC-12.basis: Config Backup uses StationContext-selected device, React Query mutations own export/preview/restore operation state, and no device lifecycle state was added to useDeviceStore/useDeviceSync.

AC-13.basis: PostgreSQL and broker runtime checks passed, but no controller runtime/hardware is available for end-to-end post-commit controller confirmation.

AC-14.basis: No P1.6 journal redesign, P1.7 API consolidation, P1.8 route redesign, P1.9 broad schema cleanup, or P1.10 observability redesign was introduced.

known_gaps: Station-wide and controller-only backup scopes are represented by the canonical scope type but are intentionally rejected by the current device-scoped API because their persistent domain mapping is not defined in P1.5 implementation scope.
No physical controller runtime is available, so post-commit remote sync failure and controller acknowledgement remain code-path verified, not hardware/runtime verified.
Backup history endpoint/storage is not implemented; history is optional in the P1.5 spec.
